chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 — Primary Source (3 points) — Set 2: communism & decolonization in Africa
chunks.content: AP World History SAQ 2 (Primary Source), 3 points, one per part. Set 2 prompts: A [1] identify one reason United States officials were concerned about communism, as noted in the source; B [1] describe the historical situation that resulted in the 'system of colonialism' referred to; C [1] explain one way the source reflects the political situation in Africa during the second half of the twentieth century. 'Identify' = correct answer; 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: C describing the political situation rather than explaining how the source reflects it.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Identified a reason for US concern about communism, described the historical situation behind colonialism, and explained how the source reflects Africa's political situation. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 2/3 (A 0, B 1, C 1). Earned B (historical situation) and C (how the source reflects the situation) but not A (did not identify a valid reason for US concern about communism). Illustrates missing the first Identify part while completing the later parts.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 1, C 0). Earned only B (historical situation). Lost A (no valid reason for US concern) and C (no explanation of how the source reflects the situation). Illustrates a response holding only the contextual describe part.
